QuestInfo.name: Remembering, Bit by Bit
QuestInfo.0: Get the Tinglebrain Potion from the Sorcerer.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver the Tinglebrain Potion to the Amnesiac Temple Keeper.
QuestInfo.2:
The Tinglebrain Potion wasn't effective on the Amnesiac Temple Keeper.
How old are they, anyway? They seem to be ANCIENT!

0.0: Here you are and BE CAREFUL. Just one sip, and BAM! Memory city! There might be a FEW #rside effects#k... but that's the risk you take. It's not fruit punch, ya know?

yes.0: I hope your friend's memories were worth the million mesos! Hehehehehe!

no.0: I thought your precious amnesiac friend was desperate? This potion heals headaches, backaches, toothaches, and arthritis on TOP of recovering memories! You REALLY don't need it?

1.0: What's this? Tinglebrain Potion?! Oh wow, thank you so much!

yes.0: I thought this stuff was supposed to...

npc.0: You still haven't taken the potion to Amnesiac Temple Keeper? I don't think it will be of any use to you... Just give it to him, will you?

item.0: I still don't remember anything... What kind of person was I? And why was I found in the Gate of the Past?

lost.0: You drank it didn't you? Well, don't worry about the intense burning, it should go away in a few weeks. Here's another batch for your unfortunate friend.
